name: How long does a typical stair safety upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical stair safety upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a stair safety upgrade project varies significantly based on the complexity and scope of the work. Minor upgrades, such as installing new handrails or anti-slip treads, might take a few days. More extensive projects, like structural repairs, full staircase replacement, or custom design elements, could extend to several weeks. Factors like material availability, permits required, and coordination with other trades also influence the timeline. A detailed project schedule will be provided after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline for a stair safety upgrade varies: minor work might take days, while complex projects with structural changes or custom designs could take several weeks, depending on scope, materials, and permits.
